messages:
alex: Thinking of doing a handheld show-and-tell at the LAN corner this Friday. Bring anything quirky or rad. Pocket mods, Deck skins, weird controllers welcome.

maya: I'm in. Bringing my Evercade + a pile of cartridges. Also a charger.

sam: I'll bring a Steam Deck (OLED) and a couple of co-op indies. Anyone want to try split-screen RTS on it?

jordan: I have a modded GBA with a backlight hack if people want to compare color palettes.

priya: quick logistics Q: do we have a dedicated HDMI for the projector? I can label plugs and tape power runners under the table.

liam: I can bring a short HDMI and a 6-outlet surge. Also a tiny USB-C hub for charging.

maya: poll: do you want a 8-bit music playlist during the handheld showcase? react :musical_note: yes / :no_entry_sign: no

alex: yes to tunes. Also can someone bring sticky notes for labeling controllers? Last time they wandered.

game-bot: FYI: venue policy says no open flames, but snacks are OK. Also image: https://i.imgur.com/handheldcorner.jpg

sam: for swaps: I have an extra Steam game key (indie coop) if anyone wants to trade a microSD 256GB. DM me.

jordan: curious if anyone's tried local wireless link play between Pocket and GB carts. Sounds finicky but worth a test.

priya: we'll set up a hot-swappable station: 1 table for demos, 1 couch for co-op, 1 bench for swaps/repairs.

alex: perfect. Bring chargers, backups, and good vibes. See you Friday 7pm — corner by the plants.
